# Quest E-sports LK

Quest E-sports LK is a Sri Lankan esports organization and tournament platform.

## Primary pages

- Home: https://questesports.lk/
- Tournaments: https://questesports.lk/tournaments
- Match videos: https://questesports.lk/match-videos
- Event tickets: https://questesports.lk/tickets
- Shop: https://questesports.lk/shop
- Gallery: https://questesports.lk/gallery
- Members: https://questesports.lk/members
- Contact: https://questesports.lk/contact

## Discovery

- Sitemap: https://questesports.lk/sitemap.xml
- Robots policy: https://questesports.lk/robots.txt

Public tournament, ticket, product, and rulebook pages may be discovered through the sitemap and their respective index pages.
